description: This PHP class `EmployeeDirectoryDao` is part of a plugin for OrangeHRM and provides data access methods related to employee directory operations, such as retrieving employee lists and counts, with filtering capabilities.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Employee Directory, providing methods to fetch employee data with filtering, pagination, and count functionalities.

methods.name: getEmployeeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeListQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a QueryBuilderWrapper object with filters and joins based on search parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches an employee entity based on their employee number.

search-terms: employee filter by name or ID
